history.summary: A large 1787sqft 4BR in Sea Esta, D18 (Pasir Ris/Tampines East) at $2.3M / $1287 psf — about 3% below the $1327 median, with a reliable 4.6% CAGR over 103 transactions. Solid OCR fundamentals with CRL/DTL-extension catalysts; the constraints are a high quantum for a 4BR and no MRT proximity listed.
history.rating_rationale: $1287 psf is ~3% under median and the 4.6% appreciation is reliable (103 txns) and above the OCR baseline — D18 benefits from Tampines Regional Centre and the CRL + DTL extension. $2.3M for a genuine 1787sqft 4BR is a fair family-quantum (not an oversized-PSF trick — it's a real large 4BR). Liquidity caveats: $2.3M and 4BR narrow the buyer pool, and no MRT is listed (Pasir Ris fringe). On balance the verified appreciation, below-median entry and D18 catalysts make it a Buy for a family-targeted hold.

history.summary: A 3BR at Sea Esta (Pasir Ris, OCR) asking ~S$1,205 psf against a verified 12-month transacted average of ~S$1,325-1,347 psf — a genuine, web-confirmed discount of roughly 9-10%, backed by a deep 103-transaction history.
history.rating_rationale: The algo's very_low_psf flag and -21.6% age-adjusted premium hold up against real transactions: SRX/EdgeProp show 12-month sales averaging S$1,325-1,347 psf (Nov 2025 high of S$1,608 psf for a same-size 1,119 sqft unit), so the S$1,205 psf ask is ~9-10% below recent comps rather than a mis-scrape. The appreciation signal rests on 103 transactions (robust, not a quirk), and the unit sits in the OCR — the strongest forward region under v3.4 priors (realized fwd OCR ~+4.0%). The -13.3% cohort premium on 13 txns adds corroboration. Confidence is medium not high because the catalyst is generic (mature Pasir Ris, no dated MRT/zone trigger) and the model explains <10% of forward variance; the edge here is verified relative value, which is the robust signal.
red_flags: 99-year leasehold from 2012 (TOP 2015) — ~86 years left, lease decay begins to weigh over a 5-7yr hold
very_low_psf flag — verified as real here, but Pasir Ris is a softer OCR pocket with limited price-growth catalysts
Pasir Ris is far from CBD; rental tenant pool is narrower than central OCR estates
catalysts: Asking ~9-10% below verified recent same-size transactions (real cheap-vs-comp value)
OCR location — best realized forward-return region under v3.4 backtest priors
Pasir Ris town centre / Pasir Ris MRT (EWL + future CRL Cross Island Line interchange) precinct rejuvenation
